scope: All 49 standalone više/najviše comparative and superlative adverbs in the Latin sources.
choice: Normalize više to official vyše and najviše to official najvyše, leaving adjective and verbal roots outside scope.
motivation: Every site means more, no longer, more than, one more, or at most. Official grammar and dictionary use vyše/najvyše; više/najviše occur only as national comparator forms.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining South-only surface forms leaves an avoidable national stratum.
A root-wide replacement could corrupt unrelated adjectives or verbs.
